title: Do bibliometrics introduce gender, institutional or interdisciplinary biases into research evaluations?
findings: The study found that for the academic field of 'Theology & Religious Studies', both article-level and journal-level citation counts have a zero or negative correlation with peer-reviewed quality scores. This suggests that using bibliometrics for research evaluation in this field is problematic and can disadvantage high-quality departments, a finding consistent with other fields in the arts and humanities.
